errors.text_span: като показва промяната на две показателни величини – вероятно импулс на инфлацията и импулс на заплатите – по време на определен период
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assumes there are two main variables being plotted and invents what they might be ('impulse of inflation and impulse of salaries'). The plot shows one main response (blue line) and its confidence interval (red lines), not two separate variables.

errors.text_span: В графиката са изобразени две линии
errors.evidence: The chart clearly shows three lines: one solid blue line and two dotted red lines. The description incorrectly states there are only two.
The description speculates on the time units for the x-axis ('probably months or quarters'), which are not specified in the figure.

errors.text_span: Втората линия е червена, пунктирана, и започва при стойност около 1.0 при X = 1, показва леко растящ тренд до около 1.4 при X = 3, след което постепенно намалява и достига стойност около –0.5 при X = 8.
errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly describes the two distinct dotted red lines as a single line. It merges the starting point and initial trend of the upper red line with the decreasing trend and approximate end point of the lower red line, creating a description of a line that does not exist.
Within the fabricated description of the 'second line', the end value is incorrect. The lower red dotted line actually ends at a value closer to -0.8 or -0.9, not -0.5.

The description completely fails to mention the relationship between the lines. The two red dotted lines form a confidence interval or band around the central blue line, which is a critical feature of an impulse response function plot.
